recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit for FHIR-43105. No core source follow-up is needed for this issue; handle FHIR-54624 separately only in a run scoped for Resolved - change required issues.
issue_request: FHIR-43105 asked for coded reject reasons for ServiceRequest. The final Applied/Not Persuasive with Modification resolution said performer rejection reasons belong on Task.statusReason, while ServiceRequest should gain ServiceRequest.statusReason as a 0..* CodeableConcept with an example binding to ServiceRequest status-reason codes including no-longer-clinically-necessary and pre-approval-denied, plus guidance about overlap with ServiceRequest.reason early in request performance.
initial_application: Git commit 463d59d511 added ServiceRequest.statusReason to source/servicerequest/structuredefinition-ServiceRequest.xml, added the ServiceRequest status-reason CodeSystem and ValueSet, and updated Request-pattern mapping exceptions. Commit dc2b4be882 made follow-up OID cleanup for the same issue. Current source retains the element, binding, requested examples, and overlap guidance.
additional_context: OO minutes from 2023-11-27 and 2024-07-30/2024-08-06 capture early discussion and Lloyd's concern that rejection belongs on Task. OO minutes from 2025-01-21 record reopening FHIR-43105 and approving Not Persuasive with Modification 8-0-0. Earlier FHIR-34491 resolved a generic ServiceRequest.statusReason request as no-change, while FHIR-43105 is the later applied, narrower decision. FHIR-54624 later refined the same element definition to remove nonexistent status names; it remains Resolved - change required and was not decided in this default-scope run.
reconciliation: No source change was made. source/fhir.ini actively includes ServiceRequest in the build, and the current ServiceRequest StructureDefinition contains ServiceRequest.statusReason as 0..* CodeableConcept with an example binding to http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/servicerequest-status-reason. The bound CodeSystem contains no-longer-clinically-necessary and pre-approval-denied, and the element comment contains the required overlap guidance with ServiceRequest.reason.
